info.name: Gainsight Companies API
info.description:
Operations tagged Companies across 2 of this provider's published API definitions: gainsight-cs-company-api-openapi.yml, gainsight-rest-api-openapi.yml. Each path carries the servers of the definition it was published in.

Contact Support:
 Name: Gainsight Support
 Email: support@gainsight.com
